beats.name: Intro
beats.vo: I'm Richard Torcato. I've built for the web since 1997, and now I ship open-source tools daily.

beats.name: The loop
beats.vo: Everything I make runs through one loop: scaffold, build, brand, repeat. Fourteen public projects, all free.

beats.name: Scaffold: repo-tooling
beats.vo: Step one: scaffold. repo-tooling is a wizard that sets up TypeScript, linting, testing and releases for any JavaScript project.

beats.name: Build: repo-ai
beats.vo: Step two: build. repo-ai turns AI-ready GitHub issues into reviewed pull requests, with one worktree per issue and two agent reviewers.

beats.name: Brand: brand-kit
beats.vo: Step three: brand. brand-kit generates a banner, a social card and a favicon for any repo.

beats.name: Repeat
beats.vo: Then I do it all again.

beats.name: Libraries
beats.vo: Underneath are eight libraries: small, tree-shakeable packages for TypeScript, React, Swift, Cloudflare, databases and Supabase.

beats.name: Products
beats.vo: And real products: homelab-nut automates UPS shutdowns, buzz-dashboard runs my agent hive, and pentest does a Docker-based security sweep.

beats.name: How I build
beats.vo: I build with Claude Code and a group of review agents, but every merge is done by hand.

beats.name: Outro
beats.vo: It's all free at torcato.dev. Start a repo the way mine start: npx @rtorcato/repo-tooling.
